originalTitle: ChatGPT Sketch turns your bad drawings into detailed AI images
summary: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Images 2.5 on Tuesday and is adding a new way to tell ChatGPT what you want it to make an image of: by drawing a doodle. With a new feature called Sketch, you can just draw something right inside ChatGPT and then tell ChatGPT how you want it to make an image […]
content: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Images 2.5 on Tuesday and is adding a new way to tell ChatGPT what you want it to make an image of: by drawing a doodle. With a new feature called Sketch, you can just draw something right inside ChatGPT and then tell ChatGPT how you want it to make an image based on that sketch. You can activate the Sketch feature by typing @Sketch into your chat box, and a window will pop up where you can make your drawing. I briefly tested it, and it successfully turned my bad doodle of a cat that I drew with my computer mouse into a realistic photo, per my instructions. You can also now leave comments directly on parts of images that you want changed, which I used to make the cat’s eyes green instead of blue. [Image: Here’s my original doodle and the first image ChatGPT made of the cat, which had green eyes. I asked for blue after. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-08-at-1.08.36-PM.png?quality=90&strip=all] As for ChatGPT Images 2.5, OpenAI says that it makes images with “more natural lighting and richer textures,” is better at following your editing instructions “across multiple turns,” and that image generation latency has been reduced by “up to 50% compared with Images 2.0.” ChatGPT Images 2.5 is out now for ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex users on desktop, mobile, and web, according to OpenAI. [Media: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6l7ble9P74o]

chineseContent: OpenAI 于周二发布了 ChatGPT Images 2.5，并添加了一种新的方式来告诉 ChatGPT 你想要它制作什么图像：通过绘制涂鸦。借助名为 Sketch 的新功能，您可以直接在 ChatGPT 内绘制一些内容，然后告诉 ChatGPT 您希望它如何根据该草图制作图像。您可以通过在聊天框中输入@Sketch来激活草图功能，然后会弹出一个窗口，您可以在其中进行绘图。我简单地测试了它，它按照我的指示成功地将我用电脑鼠标画的一只猫的糟糕涂鸦变成了一张逼真的照片。您现在还可以直接在您想要更改的图像部分留下评论，我用它来将猫的眼睛变成绿色而不是蓝色。 [图片：这是我的原创涂鸦和 ChatGPT 制作的第一张猫的图像，它有绿眼睛。后来我要了蓝色。 https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-08-at-1.08.36-PM.png?quality=90&strip=all] 至于 ChatGPT Images 2.5，OpenAI 表示它可以制作具有“更自然的光照和更丰富的纹理”的图像，能够更好地“跨多个回合”遵循您的编辑指令，并且该图像生成延迟“与 Images 2.0 相比减少了 50%”。据 OpenAI 称，ChatGPT Images 2.5 现已面向桌面、移动和网络上的 ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 用户推出。 [媒体：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6l7ble9P74o]
